# `charset`

Byte-order mark handling. preserve keeps whatever the file arrived with.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `utf-8` |  |
| `utf-8-bom` |  |
| `preserve` |  |

**Default:** `preserve`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```

### `charset = utf-8`

```ini
charset = utf-8
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `charset = utf-8-bom`

```ini
charset = utf-8-bom
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `charset = preserve`

```ini
charset = preserve
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
